Esri World Imagery with the per-site coordinates (38.6865,-100.9235 at 450 m; Lakeview loop at 110 m), 2026-11-06 (imagery predates the 2026 drawdown): Lakeview 110-112 sit on the outer side of their loop road, ~30-40 m from the lake on open mowed grass with nothing between; the rest of Lakeview is behind the loop road. Circle Drive is ~150 m south of the lake's west arm and ~100 m+ from the east shore behind the park road and the Flatland primitive area, whose pads (427-433) line the shore. Stored pin (38.6863,-100.9222) is in Circle Drive.

min_stay.season: Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day weekends (2027 rule)

values.note: Utility sites reserved site-specific on Kansas's ReserveAmerica site (campitks.gov). 2027 holiday minimum: 3 nights over Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends. Up to 14 consecutive nights in one campground; to stay longer a guest must move to a different campground within the park. Most primitive areas are not reservable (KDWP).
Four full-hookup sites (Circle Drive 039-042); the other 50 utility sites are water and electric, all at 50/30/20 A.

note: Spring-fed 100-acre lake in a wooded canyon 11 miles north of Scott City, with El Cuartelejo pueblo ruins in the park. Lakeview loop's east-side sites are the ones by the water. Since 2026-07 KDWP has been partly draining the lake to clear a bacteria and algae problem, with a KDHE no-contact advisory from 2026-06-25 (KDWP alerts, read 2026-11-06). --Claude
